action: Treat as one participant; do not concatenate signals across the gap.

issue: Ended early; tags cover 60-85 rpm only (constraint file says 90 rpm reached).
action: Use completed stages only; exclude from peak-effort comparisons.

issue: Ended early after 95 rpm.
action: Use completed stages only; exclude from peak-effort comparisons.

action: Use S11_a stages 60-105 rpm; treat S11_b as unlabelled.

issue: Did not perform the aerobic protocol (no folder).
IBI.csv is empty.
action: No E4 IBI; re-derive beats from BVP if needed.

issue: Last (3rd) sprint missing.
action: Use sprints 1-2.

issue: tags.csv is an empty file (0 bytes).
action: Whole file = baseline.

issue: tags.csv rows 5 and 6 are out of chronological order.
action: Sort tags before segmentation (done in src/data/protocol.py).

action: Do not use rpm_90_95 for these sessions.

issue: Group session with a ~7-min 90/95-rpm stage (nominal 4:30) and short cooldown.
action: Use observed durations; model group session as a factor.

issue: First tag at t = 1 s: no pre-protocol baseline recorded.
action: No baseline for this session.

issue: TEMP holds non-physical values (207-229 C) for 100% of the recording (sensor fault codes).
action: Exclude TEMP.

issue: TEMP non-physical (>200 C) for the first 220 s; remainder < 30 C.
action: Mask values > 45 C; interpret low TEMP with caution.

issue: TEMP non-physical (>200 C) for 91.5% of the recording.
action: Exclude TEMP.

issue: TEMP non-physical (>200 C) for 61.9% of the recording.
action: Mask values > 45 C; likely exclude TEMP.

issue: ACC z-axis stuck at +127 (saturation) for 93% of samples; magnitude invalid.
action: Exclude ACC magnitude; x/y axes may still carry movement information.

issue: BVP exactly zero for 13.7% of samples (runs up to 75 s); only 1 IBI detected, yet HR.csv still reports values.
action: Treat HR as unreliable; exclude from HR/HRV analyses.

issue: Empatica HR is often physiologically implausible during cycling (flat, falling with workload, or very high at low workload). In ~1/4 of aerobic V1 stages HR or the BVP dominant frequency coincides with the pedalling cadence.
action: Phase 2: per-segment HR quality index (BVP SQI, cadence coincidence, monotonicity with workload) before any HR analysis.

issue: E4 IBI coverage is low: median 58% of stress recordings, ~19% of exercise recordings; gaps up to 23 min. IBI values are quantised to 1/64 s (15.6 ms).
action: HRV only in segments meeting a coverage threshold; prefer stress/rest segments; consider re-deriving beats from BVP.

issue: Skin temperature needs several minutes to equilibrate after the band is put on; 13 sessions have >20% of samples below 30 C.
action: Discard the first minutes; analyse within-session change rather than absolute values.

issue: HR.csv starts 10 s after the other signals (10-s averaging window).
action: Align HR on its own start time, never by sample index.
